definitions.gloss: outside the vehicle; outside the train or car
definitions.explanation: The space outside a train, car, or other vehicle. The antonym of {車内|しゃない} (inside the vehicle). Common in transit announcements and traffic-safety contexts.

examples.japanese: {車外|しゃがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: to get out of the vehicle

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧です⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{車外|しゃがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}さないで→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: It is dangerous, so please do not lean out of the vehicle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{車外|しゃがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投|な}げ{出|だ}される→投げ出す：10589_nagedasu⟧おそれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The impact of a crash can throw passengers out of the vehicle.

notes:
The antonym of ⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧ (inside the vehicle). Common in transit announcements and traffic-safety warnings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車外|しゃがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get out of the vehicle
- {車外|しゃがい}⟦{放出|ほうしゅつ}→放出：12926_houshutsu⟧: being thrown from a vehicle
- {車外|しゃがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: the scenery outside the vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧: inside the vehicle — the direct antonym
